name: swarm-app
description: Standalone Electron app for the Factory work stream

scripts.build:host: bun build ./main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=./dist/main.js --external electron && bun build ./preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=./dist/preload.js --external electron
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:host
